evaluation_setup.duplicate_handling: Exact duplicate files were grouped by SHA-256 before the clean split was created.

benchmark_note: Forward-pass benchmark uses FP32, batch size 1, a Tesla T4, 5 warm-up runs and 30 timed runs. Video decoding and preprocessing are excluded.
historical_result_note: The earlier Week 5 test result used a split containing exact duplicate videos across splits, so it is not used as the valid comparison baseline.
